name: Nashi no Kokoro
source:
🍐 Welcome! 🍐

In this game, you’ll experience life as the protagonist of this unique universe where all of the characters... are pears! You'll get a firsthand look at what it's like to change schools mid-year, get to know your future friends a little better, and even discover your first love.

You’ll get to see a subtle introduction to the characters and an outline of the initial interaction paths, as these will determine which ones you meet. We're warning you now, it's packed with memes and silly jokes. We're guessing that's what you came across the cover for, right?

[Translated from [url=https://paolaski.itch.io/nashi-no-kokoro]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
🍐欢迎！🍐

在这款游戏中，你将作为这个独特宇宙的主角体验生活，其中所有角色……都是梨！你将亲眼目睹年中转校的感觉，更好地了解你未来的朋友，甚至发现你的初恋。

你将看到对角色的微妙介绍以及初始交互路径的概述，因为这些将决定你会遇到哪些角色。我们现在警告你，其中充满了迷因和愚蠢的笑话。我们猜你就是为了这个才看到封面的，对吧？

[译自[url=https://paolaski.itch.io/nashi-no-kokoro]Itch.io[/url]]
